profile.bio: A personal digital space, owned and curated by me.

thoughts.content: First post on my new digital home. Feels good to own my corner of the web.
Morning walk. Salt spray and early light. Shot some photos for the archive.
Reading about digital sovereignty and personal websites. This feels right.

trips.title: Up the Coast Camping
trips.description: Birdie Beach holds you the way only a place that knows you can. Two nights at Freemans — campfires, lagoon crossings, and the kind of company that doesn't need explaining.
narrative: There's a stretch of coast where the bush meets the sand and nobody pretends to be anything they're not.
We carried everything in on our backs. Set up camp under paperbarks. Someone's speaker. Someone's laugh. The lagoon cooling our feet.
Birdie has always been ours. The locals know. The water knows. You feel it the moment your shoes come off.
Golden hour went on forever. Three silhouettes against still water. Nobody reaching for a phone.

trips.title: Meredith Music Festival
trips.description: Three days in the supernatural amphitheatre. Dust, music, and no phone signal.
narrative: The amphitheatre holds you like a secret. Red dust on everything.
No signal out here. Just the bass through the ground and someone handing you a warm beer.
You sleep when the music stops. You wake when it starts again.

trips.title: Jervis Bay
trips.description: White sand, clear water, dolphins at sunrise. A weekend that felt like a week.
narrative: Hyams Beach at dawn. The sand so white it hurts to look at.
Dolphins broke the surface while we were still half asleep. Nobody had a camera ready. That was the point.
We stayed until the light turned gold and the bay went still.
